relationships.subject: CB2 receptor agonists
relationships.evidence_quote: Selective cannabinoid type 1, cannabinoid type 2, nonselective cannabinoid receptor agonists (including delta-9-tetrahydrocannabinol) and peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor-alpha agonists (predominantly palmitoylethanolamide) significantly attenuated pain-associated behaviours in a broad range of inflammatory and neuropathic pain models.

relationships.subject: FAAH inhibitors
relationships.evidence_quote: Fatty acid amide hydrolase inhibitors, monoacylglycerol lipase inhibitors, and cannabidiol significantly attenuated pain-associated behaviours in neuropathic pain models but yielded mixed results in inflammatory pain models.

key_findings: Meta-analysis of 374 rodent studies: cannabinoids and ECS modulators significantly attenuated pain behaviours (overall SMD 1.321).
Risk of bias unclear owing to poor reporting of randomisation, blinding and sample size.
